epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the number of stuck subjects awaiting manual review to 0 by automating resolution of poka-yoke retirements
requirements: R1: Automatically unblock subjects stuck in iteration-admission poka-yoke by implementing a system patch or automated state override that doesn't rely on human judgment

slices.title: Automate resolution of poka-yoke retired subjects
slices.jtbd: When implementing the resolution for this epic, I want to automatically reset or appropriately route subjects retired by poka-yoke guards, so that the operations auditor is no longer blocked
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an operations auditor subject is stuck with a 'Blocked task retired by iteration-admission poka-yoke' error, When the automated resolution patch is applied, Then the system programmatically handles the state to re-admit or process the requirement
Given the factory has no human to hand the subject to, When the automated resolution executes, Then no human review is required and the subject is no longer stuck
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of poka-yoke stuck subjects are automatically processed without manual intervention

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce instances of missing code for reported completed work on main to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: Source control merge and state synchronization
requirements: R1: Deliver the missing patch for Runtime Contract 9b58412d directly onto main branch

slices.title: Deliver missing patch for Runtime Contract 9b58412d
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to deliver the code changes for Runtime Contract 9b58412d to main, so that the missing implementation is present
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the missing patch for Runtime Contract 9b58412d, When the system is built on main, Then the code change is present in the repository
Given the task status is done but merge evidence is missing, When the patch is delivered, Then the discrepancy between task status and actual code state is resolved
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of reported work for the runtime contract is actually merged into main

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Bring 'reviewConcerns' u-chart back within control limits and reduce task plan validation failures to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Task plan validation gateway and pattern generation
requirements: R1: Patch the existing code to resolve the root cause of the out-of-control review concerns pattern causing task plan validation failures

slices.title: Resolve out-of-control review concerns pattern
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to patch the code that causes the review concerns, so that the Six Sigma u-chart returns to control
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a statistically confirmed pattern of design review concerns, When the existing code is patched, Then the review concern rate drops to expected levels
Given the epic quality target, When the root cause is resolved, Then task plan validation passes successfully and failures are reduced to 0%
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure the 'reviewConcerns' stream u-value returns inside the control limits [0.0000, 0.7803]
